method_input.plan_text:
Entities:
- A (resource): name = "A"; capacity = 40.
- E2: own_stock = 30; required = 100; available = 30; coverage = 0.3; shortfall = 70; status = "PARTIAL".
- office wifi: name = "office wifi".
Links:
- none.
Link kinds: 'requires', 'supports', 'causes', 'blocks', 'enables' and 'derived_from' carry influence from the first entity to the second; 'informs' and 'references' do not carry influence. An 'influencing link into X' means one of the first kind ending at X.
Rules:
- available of E2 = (own_stock of E2 + [capacity of A, counted only while A has an influencing link into E2; otherwise 0]).
- coverage of E2 = (available of E2 ÷ required of E2).
- shortfall of E2 = the larger of (0, (required of E2 − available of E2)).
- status of E2 is "FULL" if (coverage of E2 ≥ 1); "INVALID" if (coverage of E2 ≤ 0); otherwise "PARTIAL".
